scientific_integrity: The classical optimum is proved analytically for arbitrary measurable local binary responses and shared randomness. The packaged checker supplies only finite regression tests; it is not used to infer the infinite-dimensional optimum. The direct source and the closest fixed-angle sphere-colouring paper were inspected at statement level.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the classical optimum and certifies a quantum advantage from the displayed singlet strategy. It does not prove that the singlet value \(3/4\) is the global quantum optimum, and it uses Lévy spherical isoperimetry as a standard geometric input.
title: Exact classical value of the three-dimensional continuous-input sign game
